build_resnet_model: build a Haiku ResNet model with configurable blocks, channels, and strides for image classification
build_resnet50_model: build a Haiku ResNet50 model with bottleneck blocks for a given number of classes
build_resnet18_model: build a lightweight Haiku ResNet18 model without bottleneck blocks for a given number of classes
review_blockv1_blockv2: review the BlockV1 and BlockV2 residual block implementations to compare pre-activation and post-activation patterns
review_resnet_configs: review the ResNet CONFIGS dictionary to understand block counts and channel sizes for variants 18 through 200
